titulo: All fifteen minutes of the break
caption:
All fifteen minutes of the break

Fifteen minutes, all fifteen. The screen waited, and the next task came in sharper.

A short break is a short break only if it ends on its own, and the cup finishes warm.

For whoever takes the whole break and leaves the screen alone.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a long table, a small computer screen at the right, a clock in the middle that says 15:00 and a steaming mug at the left. A ink-black block figure with narrowed white eyes trembles in the middle looking toward the screen, then its eyes go wide and it turns and walks to the mug while the clock counts down to 0:00. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text changes from: me, five minutes is plenty, to: took all fifteen. came back sharp.
